source_snapshot.procedure: Install nvqual, run PCI Express qualification and check GPU sensors.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Master Script URL points to thermal-test; correct wrapper and path/link/eye oracle required.

old_problem: The Master Item/Procedure/Criteria consistently require PCIe qualification but its Script URL names the thermal wrapper, risking false coverage; exact artifact, topology and link/eye oracle were also absent.
disposition_reason: The three authoritative semantic fields establish PCIe qualification; the conflicting thermal Script cannot execute or receive credit. ED-03 permits the correct reviewed PCIe wrapper and topology values as mandatory runtime bindings without modifying Master.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row374 all 18 XLSX columns and history2967.
Preserved PCIe qualification, GPU sensor check and every path/subtest while explicitly rejecting the thermal wrapper.
No NVQual artifact, link test, retrain or load ran.

test_case.test_name: NVQual PCIe link/eye qualification with path-level evidence
test_case.purpose: Run the approved PCIe-specific NVQual qualification for every labeled GPU path and prove link/eye results, negotiated state, errors and platform health all satisfy signed rules.
required_package: Licensed NVQual provenance/version/checksum and stack compatibility
Correct reviewed PCIe wrapper/hash; thermal wrapper prohibited
GPU UUID/BDF/bridge/root-port topology and optional-node rules
Expected speed/width, eye fields and AER/error limits
Cooling/power/PSU/OOB hard stops and link-recovery plan
test_case.test_command: After artifact, wrapper, topology, isolation and approval gates, capture link/error baseline and execute the pinned PCIe-specific NVQual qualification once for the source 20-minute allocation; retain every path/subtest and synchronized platform telemetry, then verify final links/services.
test_case.expected_result: Every required path/subtest passes the signed link/eye oracle, all GPUs remain enumerated at approved speed/width, no prohibited AER/error or platform sensor excursion occurs, and final health is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Only the pinned PCIe wrapper and path-level results count; the thermal wrapper, aggregate PASS without link evidence, or a narrowed/degraded link cannot pass.
safety_gate: Reject the Master thermal-test URL for execution
Explicit approval for link qualification and workload drain
Preserve AER/log evidence and monitor OOB/thermal/power
Abort on retrain, downgrade, disappearance or safety event; no retry
expected_evidence: NVQual artifact/license/checksum and corrected wrapper hash
Pre/post links, eye fields and AER/error counters
Platform telemetry, stop record and restored links/services
test_case.recovery: Abort on path or platform anomaly, preserve evidence, use OOB to verify host/device state, restore only owner-approved runtime/link state, isolate a degraded path and do not rerun automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Review-layer routing follows the consistent PCIe Item/Procedure/Criteria and explicitly forbids the mismatched thermal Script from execution or evidence credit.

blocked.reason: The correct test semantics are clear; exact wrapper/topology/oracle are runtime gates.

pending.unlock_condition: Approve the corrected immutable PCIe qualification package.
